    Examples

    Example: CubeExample

    ![../_images/CubeExample-1.png](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/_images/CubeExample-1.png)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class CubeExample(ThreeDScene):
        def construct(self):
            self.set_camera_orientation(phi=75*DEGREES, theta=-45*DEGREES)

            axes = ThreeDAxes()
            cube = Cube(side_length=3, fill_opacity=0.7, fill_color=BLUE)
            self.add(cube)
    ```
